meta.combo_padding_note: Booksy applies the trailing 10-min padding to combos automatically from the last component service. Do NOT add extra minutes into the combo duration — that double-pads and wastes 10 min of chair time per package. Combo duration = sum of components, nothing more.

categories.name: Precision Haircuts

services.name: The Executive
services.desc: The house specialty. Wash and cut, shaped entirely with shears — no clippers, no guards — every line judged by eye and cut by hand. It takes longer, and it should: the result grows out softer, sits more naturally, and never leaves a hard shelf across the back.

services.name: The Signature
services.desc: Wash and cut. Electric clippers and traditional shears working together, seamlessly blended. A gentle hand throughout — nobody should leave a haircut feeling roughed up.

services.name: The Fresh Fade
services.desc: Wash and cut. A clippers-only skin fade, blended by hand from a bare skin line up through the longer hair on top — a graduated blend rather than one uniform length, with sharp edges and a clean modern finish.

services.name: The Regiment
services.desc: Wash and cut. The classic crew cut — clippers only, short through the back and sides with a bit more length left on top. A uniform short length rather than a skin fade, so it keeps its shape as it grows. Easy to maintain, endlessly versatile, always a neat and clean finish.

services.name: The Royal Roots
services.desc: Wash and cut for our youngest gentlemen. Patient, unhurried, and taken as seriously as any cut in the chair — kids notice when someone takes their time with them.

categories.note: In the chair, I use Reuzel hair products.

services.name: The Sovereign
services.desc: The Executive cut paired with The Majesty Hot Towel Shave.

services.name: The Regent

services.name: The Officer

services.name: The Gentleman

services.name: The Diplomat

services.name: The Majesty Hot Towel Shave
services.desc: Our most indulgent ritual. Facial steam, exfoliation, warm aromatic towels, a traditional straight-razor shave, and a customized mini facial to finish. Clients call it calming, soothing, and more than just a shave — you leave feeling brand new.

services.name: The Royal Hot Towel Shave
services.desc: A meticulously curated hot towel shave with beard trim. Warm towels and premium products prepare the skin for a traditional straight-razor shave, finished close and comfortable.

services.name: The Statesman Beard Shaping
services.desc: Full beard sculpting and detailing with clippers, shaped to your face with clean, deliberate lines. Hot towel included.

services.name: Scalp Treatment
services.desc: A cleansing, nourishing therapy that soothes the scalp and promotes healthier hair growth. Deeply relaxing on its own or paired with any cut.

services.name: Nose Waxing
services.desc: Precise removal of nasal hair for a polished look.

services.name: Ear Waxing
services.desc: Gentle, hygienic removal of excess ear hair.

services.name: Eyebrow Waxing
services.desc: Sculpting and shaping to define your look with precision.

services.name: Grey Blending
services.desc: A refined technique to create a soft, natural transition with our professional grey blending service.
